name: Two Michigan Pergolas
lede: In Livonia and Chelsea, a Detroit-area StruXure dealer built Bromic radiant heaters into louvred pergolas with motorised screens, so two backyards stay inviting as the temperature drops.

beats: In Livonia, a roof-mounted StruXure pergola attaches to the house, with motorised louvres and solar screens. In Chelsea, an elevated patio sits under a three-zone pergola with screens and an outdoor kitchen.
Both owners wanted a four-season room in a cold state: louvred roof and screens, with heat that keeps the space in use as autumn comes in.
In both homes, Skyview built Bromic heaters into the pergola structure. Neither project page gives the model or the count.
